instructions.question: What overall polarity does this French tweet convey about the situation, event or topic it reports (often ecology, energy, climate), reading its wording at face value?
instructions.rule: Positive needs an outcome framed as good: success, approval, award, reinforcement, protection, celebration, praise or advocacy (ironic praise counts literally). Negative needs harm, threat, decline, suspension, scandal, opposition, criticism or insult. A headline that merely presents a technology, building, project, sum of money, forecast or test, without success or approval wording, is neutral, as are puns, banter, anecdotes, agendas and meeting notices.

neutral.what: Information without a framed good/bad outcome: descriptions of technologies or projects, amounts, forecasts, tests, data, agendas, meetings, puns, chit-chat.
examples: Innovation : des tuiles transparentes pour capter l'énergie solaire http @user #energie (Innovation: transparent tiles to capture solar energy)
Un dispositif de stockage de l'#énergie solaire va être testé à #Lausanne #DD  http (A solar energy storage device will be tested in Lausanne)
L'Ademe publie l'édition 2014 des chiffres-clés des #déchets (Ademe publishes the 2014 key figures on waste)
"On peut vendre du vent, regarde les éoliennes" (You can sell wind, look at wind turbines)
neutral.cues: publie (publishes), réunion (meeting), va être testé (will be tested), pourrait (could), millions, ?, chiffres (figures), puns on vent (wind)
neutral.not_for: Headlines with success/approval wording are positive; harm or suspension is negative.

positive.what: Achievements, approvals, awards, reinforced support, protections, celebrations, praise, thanks, enthusiasm, calls to act for a cause, or literal praise used ironically.
examples: Areva : Les 80 éoliennes du parc de Global Tech I installées avec succès http (Areva: the 80 turbines of the Global Tech I park successfully installed)
#ecologie Rénovation énergétique : des aides renforcées depuis le 1er septembre http (Energy renovation: reinforced subsidies since 1 September)
Les écologistes applaudissent la décision de Ségolène Royal (Ecologists applaud Ségolène Royal's decision)
Au Testet, la police stimule la croissance en coupant les arbres (At Testet, police stimulate growth by cutting trees)
positive.cues: avec succès (successfully), renforcées (reinforced), applaudissent (applaud), salue (hails), rassure (reassures), lauréat (winner), à l'honneur (honoured), feu vert (green light), bravo, merci, super, :D
positive.not_for: Bare presentations of a green technology, project, sum or forecast are neutral.

negative.what: Threats, damage, deaths, decline, suspensions, scandals, opposition, criticism, anger or insults.
examples: Le manchot empereur victime du réchauffement climatique http (The emperor penguin, victim of global warming)
Suspension sine die de l'#ecotaxe http (Indefinite suspension of the ecotax)
@user Les éoliennes défigurent nos jolies campagnes. (Wind turbines disfigure our countryside.)
negative.cues: menacée (threatened), victime (victim), péril, suspension, scandale, enfer (hell), opposition, craintes (fears), détruit (destroyed), inutile (useless)
negative.not_for: Ironic praise phrased positively is positive; harmless jokes are neutral.
